Tax Analyst

PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS) is a subsidiary of PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (Chandra Asri Group) established to deliver Shared Service Center (SSC) solutions that support the Group’s growing business operation.

Our commitment is to empower Chandra Asri Group’s transformation and long-term growth by becoming a trusted strategic partner in business support and service delivery.

CASS plays a vital role in enhancing efficiency, standardizing process and driving operational excellence across the Group’s subsidiaries-including entities based in Singapore.

Role Purpose

This role is responsible for accurate execution of standard Tax activities and to ensure compliance, accuracy in tax calculation, reconciliations, and reporting as well as audit readiness within a managed services environment. This role focuses on disciplined execution, adherence to procedures, resolves exceptions and supports statutory reporting and close activities.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Processing & Execution

• Prepare and execute tax-related activities including calculation and filings of corporate VAT / GST / WHT / property tax, Tax reconciliations between GL, sub-ledgers, tax reports including income tax provision and deferred tax calculations, and other statutory filings in accordance with local and international tax regulations on a timely basis.
• Prepare and execute timely and accurate tax planning/scheduling and advisory activities, such as transfer pricing and cross-border transactions, remittance of tax payments, incl. estimated taxes and final settlements.
• Maintain and update tax documentation and compliance records to support tax positions and ensure compliance with applicable laws. Support onshore tax team on tax audits and inquiries by preparing necessary documentation.

Controls, Compliance & Audit

• Execute assigned Tax controls with full documentation while ensuring compliance with tax regulations, treasury policies, and internal controls.
• Support internal and external audits with reconciliations, explanations, and evidence.

Issue Resolution & Analysis

• Investigate tax discrepancies independently.
• Perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions.
• Escalate high-risk issues with clear impact assessment.

SAP & Systems Ownership

• Perform advanced transactional and analytical work in SAP Finance.
• Validate tax codes, postings, and cash-related transactions.
• Support master data checks related to tax processes.

Stakeholder & Team Support

• Participate in finance transformation initiatives, including ERP system enhancements (e.g., SAP S4 HANA).
• Assist in the implementation and monitoring of internal controls across Aster entities. Execute governance-related actions (e.g., maintain Manual of Authorities).

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve compliance efficiency and accuracy. Support SOP updates and process improvements.
• Contribute to ESSA-driven initiatives.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education Requirement

• Minimum S1 (Bachelor’s degree) in Accounting, Finance, or Taxation.
• S2 (Master’s degree) is an advantage.

Recommended Certifications

• Brevet Pajak (A/B/C)
• CPA / CA / ACCA
• Indonesian Registered Accountant (Ak.)

Skills & Experience Required Experience

This role is designed for finance professionals operating within structured compliance and cash management environments.

The ideal candidate will have:

Technical

• 2–7 years of experience in Tax roles.
• Experience in shared services or managed services environments preferred.
• Experience supporting regulated, manufacturing, or petrochemical industries is an advantage.
• Mandatory hands-on SAP Finance experience.
• Strong understanding of:
• Tax calculation and reconciliation
• Audit and regulatory compliance
• Internal control frameworks
• Experience with Tax calculation and reconciliation, as well as various aspects of direct and indirect tax compliance and reporting (Corporate tax, withholding tax, transfer pricing, GST, etc.) and governance and internal controls.
• Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP preferred).

Professional Attributes

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• High attention to detail and ownership.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Demonstrates integrity, teamwork, and a proactive mindset.
• Ability to work independently under deadlines.
• Strong proficiency/fluency in English (written and oral).

If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!

Important Notes

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma
